STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Stripe secret key (sk_test_… for testing, sk_live_… when live). Stripe dashboard → Developers → API keys.

APP_TOKEN.description: The app token shown in Business Hub → Settings → Plans & payments → Connect. Paste it exactly.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Where your Business Hub app lives. Leave as is unless you moved it.

INBOX.description: Storage for quote approvals and text replies. Created for you.
